declarations.name: AuiPasswordStrengthMeter

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Input to follow (Password Input, Text Input, or the element).

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Evaluate this value instead of following an input (framework bindings).

inputs.name: announce
inputs.description: Announce the rating and requirement count politely after typing pauses (1 s).

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The rating or a requirement changed after user input.

accessibility.pattern: Text rating plus a native list of requirements with state in text; a polite live region for debounced summaries. The segmented bar is aria-hidden (the text carries the meaning).

limitations: Requirement tests and evaluators must be synchronous.
Default rules: at least 12 characters, a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter, and a number. Mirror your server policy with the requirements option.
The default Strong rating needs all rules met and at least 16 characters; a single repeated character is always Weak.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
